name: claude-statusline
description: Show Claude Code model, thinking effort, rate-limit usage and context-window usage in the VS Code status bar.

claudeStatusline.cachePath.description: Path to the JSON cache file written by the Claude Code statusLine script. Empty string means ~/.claude/.statusline-cache.json.

claudeStatusline.refreshIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) to re-read the cache file and update the status bar.

claudeStatusline.staleThresholdSec.description: Mark data as stale and dim the status bar when the cache file mtime is older than this (seconds).

claudeStatusline.priority.description: Status bar priority (higher = closer to the centre of the bar).

commands.title: Claude Status Line: Open Cache File
